testCase.name: [dev] S12 Which patients' open tasks are in the view: Nursing Home on vs off Today's Visits; Hospital encounter complete

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S12 「哪些病人的没完成任务在界面上：养老院在 / 不在 Today's Visits 上；医院床旁已完成」 Which patients' open tasks are in the view: Nursing Home on vs off Today's Visits; Hospital encounter complete

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed)（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.6；TFA-92585 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Standard fixture; the agent adds an open task on the resident; a seeded Hospital patient whose encounter is complete with a kept open task

When Open Nursing Home Task Export; take the resident off Today's Visits (All Residents toggle) and open Task Export again; put it back. Open Hospital Task Export

Then Every class keeps its open task on the view: resident on Today's Visits, resident off Today's Visits, Hospital patient with the encounter marked complete

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 'every open task across all patients' + AC 2 + AC 10: cp1, cp2 mustContain {snfResident} and 'Schedule podiatry visit'. Main hides residents not on Today's Visits (Tim's spec pins it), so cp2 is expected to fail and is reported under Q1. The Hospital encounter-complete class ('QA Hosp Dan Ito', 'Arrange outpatient echo') is in spec.deferred and runs once seeding exists; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
